video_title: RJ Barrett | Post Game at Wizards | October 23, 2026

quotes.speaker: RJ Barrett
quotes.summary_phrase: RJ Barrett on the Raptors' gritty win against the Wizards
quotes.excerpt: It was a nasty one. Couldn't make any shots, but we just hung tough, played defense.
quotes.quote: It was a nasty one. It was a nasty one. Couldn't make any shots, but we just hung tough, played defense. Found the line in the first, so I think we figured it out a little more in the second half, but grit and toughness, man. Got to be able to win those games when the shots aren't falling and things aren't going your way.
quotes.social_post: RJ Barrett on the Raptors grinding out a win against the Wizards despite a poor shooting night: It was a nasty one. Got to be able to win those games when the shots aren't falling and things aren't going your way.

structured.context: RJ Barrett discusses the Raptors' gritty victory over the Wizards after struggling with shooting efficiency.

quotes.speaker: RJ Barrett
quotes.summary_phrase: RJ Barrett on defending Trae Young and drawing fouls
quotes.excerpt: He's been in the league a while. He's going to get them calls, man.
quotes.quote: He's been in the league a while. He's going to get them calls, man. He's really good at it. As a person that gets foul calls, he got it for sure. So I'm just trying to like, hey, get my hands out the way.
quotes.social_post: RJ Barrett on defending Trae Young and navigating his ability to draw fouls: He is really good at it. As a person that gets foul calls he got it for sure. So I am just trying to get my hands out the way.

structured.context: RJ Barrett comments on the challenge of defending Trae Young and his ability to draw fouls.

quotes.speaker: RJ Barrett
quotes.summary_phrase: RJ Barrett on the Raptors' defensive strategy against Anthony Davis
quotes.excerpt: Just really trying to make his catch as tough, be physical.
quotes.quote: Scottie started on him, and we got some action. Just really trying to make his catch as tough, be physical. Yeah, just try to make him uncomfortable as much as possible, I'd say. He's obviously a great player, so great defense from us tonight. We'll see them a bunch more times, but I think we did a good job tonight.
quotes.social_post: RJ Barrett on the Raptors defensive strategy against Anthony Davis: Just really trying to make his catch as tough, be physical. Just try to make him uncomfortable as much as possible.

structured.context: RJ Barrett explains the defensive strategy used by the Raptors to contain Anthony Davis.

quotes.speaker: RJ Barrett
quotes.summary_phrase: RJ Barrett on embracing the grind of non-pretty wins
quotes.excerpt: My game's not pretty, so you know, I think for us, the game was nasty.
quotes.quote: My game's not pretty, so you know, I think for us, the game was nasty, like we said, but at the same time, the way we play defense and stuff, it's almost in our favor when it's like that. So, good teams, they figure out how to win when things are going their way, when it's not. So if we want to be a good team, we got to continue to win games like this.
quotes.social_post: RJ Barrett says the Raptors are embracing the grind of ugly wins: My game is not pretty, so I think for us, the game was nasty, but the way we play defense is almost in our favor when it is like that.

quotes.speaker: RJ Barrett
quotes.summary_phrase: RJ Barrett on maintaining defensive intensity without fouling
quotes.excerpt: We're going to play the same way the whole time.
quotes.quote: We're going to play the same way the whole time. We're fouling a lot, we'll watch some film, adjust, but we won two games, so I don't think we need to change too much in that regard.
quotes.social_post: RJ Barrett on the team's high foul count: We are fouling a lot, we will watch some film, adjust, but we won two games, so I do not think we need to change too much in that regard.

structured.context: RJ Barrett discusses the team's approach to managing foul trouble while maintaining defensive intensity.

quotes.speaker: RJ Barrett

quotes.quote: It makes it hard on the other team, making it hard on the opponents. Try to take them out of their stuff, make them uncomfortable as much as possible, and it's a team effort for sure.

quotes.summary_phrase: RJ Barrett on the impact of Collin Sexton's play
